Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Lana Dobreed & •Sacrifice (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), game text: “If your character is about to be hit, use 1 Force (free if by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon); for remainder of turn, its forfeit may not be reduced and it may not be used to satisfy attrition. OR Cancel Disarmed. [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel a ‘react.’ OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_032021.pdf Errata Sheet 2021 Spring] (Players Committee), page 1, PDF built 14 March 2021. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF; its transparent areas (where the card underneath shows through) are shown white.

Edits: none.
